caseName: Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Co. v. Cole
caseNameFull: Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Company, in Error v. Paul D. Cole
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Kansas.
attorneys: Mr. Alfred A. Scott, Mr. Robert Dunlap and Mr. Gardiner Lathrop for plaintiff in error., Mr. Alfred M. Jackson and Mr, Charles T. Atkinson for defendant in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.-

Judgment affirmed with costs and ten per cent, damages upon the authority of Chicago Junction Ry. Co. v. King, 222 U. S. 222; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Padgett, 236 U. S. 668; Great Northern Ry. Co. v. Knapp, 240 U. S. 464; Baltimore & Ohio R. R. Co. v. Whitacre, 242 U. S. 169; Southern Ry. Co. v. Puckett, 244 U. S. 571, 574.
